title: Deactivation message lines and order, from bulk and from one part
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
custom_steps:
1. Read the deactivation confirmation from a selection of several parts, then of exactly one part.
  2. Read the deactivation confirmation from one part's edit dialog.
  3. Check the wording and the order of the three lines.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • From a selection the deactivation states, in order: "These parts won't show up when adding parts to work orders, estimates, part sales or purchase orders.", "Existing records that use them stay as they are.", "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected." (singular "This part..." / "...use it..." for one part).
  • From one part's edit dialog it states, in order: "This part won't show up when adding parts to work orders, estimates, part sales or purchase orders.", "Existing records that use it stay as they are.", "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected."

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 10 (Confirming & recording a status change); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R22: “For a deactivation raised from a selection, the confirmation states, in this order: "These parts won't show up when adding parts to work orders, estimates, part sales or purchase orders.", "Existing records that use them stay as they are.", and "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected." When exactly one part is selected the lines read "This part won't show up ..." and "Existing records that use it stay as they are."”
  • S10-R22a: “For a deactivation raised from one part's edit dialog, the confirmation states, in this order: "This part won't show up when adding parts to work orders, estimates, part sales or purchase orders.", "Existing records that use it stay as they are.", and "Stock, cost of goods and QuickBooks aren't affected."”
